canonical_selector.rule: This is the only current-work selector. AAI-01..10, MAI-01..10 and ISE-01..07 are completed_verified; ISE-08 is selected_not_started only without implementation authority.

active_work.execution_rule: Selection only. A future owner Continue must establish a bounded ISE-08 governed start before any product mutation; exactly one current-family profile and zero predecessor fanout remain the intended final-validation shape.

selection_invariants: ISE-01..07 completed_verified with no further implementation authority
ISE-08 selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
future ISE-08 work must prove remote synchronization, reconnect/rejoin, stale/conflict handling and GM adjudication without replacing canonical Scene/owner state
hidden/GM-only information, protected cardinality and provider secrets remain filtered before network/player/accessibility/diagnostic/export/AI projection
mobile/tablet, keyboard and nonvisual equivalents must preserve consequential information/actions without making the visual canvas canonical
large maps, animated assets, degraded/missing media and audio-disabled operation must preserve deterministic authoritative results and nonblocking play

golden proof must span prepared Scene, live encounter, interactive object/region, audiovisual transition and post-Scene state with permission, expected-version/idempotency and owner-domain validation intact
selection reserves no migration; paid provider activation, media redistribution, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized
SSA-01 is strict successor after ISE-08 completion only and has no current authority
